title: docs(pm-dispatch): let an execution seat accept a filer-labelled card when the lane fits the domain table and the body passes the filing gate; triage spot-checks after
body:
Fixes #23733
Clause-②: no

Relaxes the lane-label rule as the maintainer ruled on the card (filing gate ③), verbatim and untranslated:

> 现在派,规则选 A；放宽:执行席可直接接收自贴标签的卡,只要车道按域表正确、正文有立卡门三件;分诊事后抽查

Scope pick B (「放宽(按我写的原文)」): the rule change only. The one-off dispatch it also ordered is already done and is not touched here.

## What changed (three files, each at net 0 lines, no `CEILINGS` move)

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`** — 〈域车道〉 L171–172 (was L172):

- L171 keeps the rule and its tail clause, renumbering the one existing exception: 「`domain:*` 只由分诊席产出,例外一:在飞卡衍生 sub-issue 承父卡域;无标签的卡 ⛔ 不得认领。」 (119 B)
- L172, new: 「例外二:立卡人自贴而车道合上表、正文齐立卡门三件 ⇒ 执行席直接认领,分诊事后抽查。」 (120 B). 「上表」 is the domain table directly above it; 「立卡门三件」 is `references/filing-gate.md` L26, referred to and not restated.
- Payment: deleted L126, the `Unlock-action:` accepted-spellings line (the two `re-check …` forms, others silently fall back). It survives at its single source, `references/state-machine.md` L28–29 (both spellings, then 「只认此二值,别的拼写静默回落重派」), and SKILL.md L124 already sends the reader there for every hold/blocked line contract. The four-axis block is untouched and still occupies L241–261 (md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`, identical before and after).

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`** — 〈候选与批次〉:

- L11, new, directly under the candidate rule: 「自贴 `domain:*` 卡:车道合域表且正文齐 `filing-gate.md` 三件 ⇒ 候选;缺一 ⇒ 挂 `pm:retriage`。」 (118 B). Either condition failing adds `pm:retriage`, and L10's candidate rule (「无 `pm:retriage`」) then excludes the card, so it reaches triage instead of waiting unseen.
- L42 (was L41): 「唯一绕过分诊」 → 「绕过分诊」. The sub-issue path is no longer the only route past triage's first touch, so the word became false. Same-line edit, −6 B.
- Payment: deleted L139 「dev 装不下预算 ⇒ 停手回报,⛔ 不自行扩写、不自行抬预算。」 It is a developer obligation whose single source is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L292 (「净增预算装不下 ⇒ 按 `blocked` 报缺口;⛔ 不自行扩写或抬预算:预算归 PM,抬它归维护者。」); `references/dispatch-runbook.md` L188 already names SKILL.md and the dev definition as the single source of dev duties. The PM-side duty on the line above (set the budget) and the review rule (over-budget ⇒ REWORK) both stay.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`** — the Backlog sweep block:

- L17, new, right after the sweep's exclusion line: 「自贴卡抽查:窗内新派发且 `domain:*` 事件与建卡同分钟者,逐张核车道、三件;⛔ 不凭 actor。」 (120 B). 「窗内」 is the hourly `since` window L8 defines (anchor = the seat post's last brief). The discriminator and why it is not the actor are measured below.
- Payment: deleted L88 「retriage 维持或改判皆由分诊席同笔摘标;挂标归异议席。」 Its first clause is L87 of the same file (「答后同笔摘标」) and `references/state-machine.md` L40; its second is what the `pm:retriage` row of SKILL.md's state table already defines (向分诊提问 … 异议评论写明所求).

## PM mechanism assumptions — measured

- (a) All readings held at `3b46855fb`: 319/319, 188/188, 120/120 lines; L172, L10 and the sweep block read as quoted; table at L160–169.
- (b) No ruling comment id exists for a raise; each file stays at its ceiling and no `CEILINGS` row moves.
- (c) Followed: the three items are referred to (`filing-gate.md`), not restated; the lane condition points at the table.
- (d) Held, with one correction: the sub-issue exception stands (SKILL.md L171, execution-duties L41–44), but execution-duties' 「唯一绕过分诊」 is no longer true and is edited.
- (e) Discriminator, measured on the public issue-page payload (`LabeledEvent` items carry `createdAt` and `actor`) and the REST events list, which agree:
  - The card's suggestion (label event by the issue's creator in the creation minute, no later triage-actor event) cannot stand as stated. On #23720 all six label events have actor `objectstack-fleet[bot]` — the filer's four at 20:01:15–16Z, seat 2's `pm:retriage` add at 20:53:44Z, triage's `pm:retriage` removal at 21:53:18Z, the PM's `pm:dispatched` at 22:26:57Z — and that is also the issue's creator. The actor half separates nothing; the timing half does (created 20:01:13Z, `domain:devx` labelled 20:01:16Z).
  - The PM's candidate (first `Claim:` with no earlier triage first-touch comment opening `## Triage:` or `## First grade`) is roster-dependent. On #23720 the only triage comment before the claim (22:27:26Z) opens with `## Retriage answered: first touch · …` (21:52:42Z), so the literal roster lists #23720 for the wrong reason, and a roster widened to that opener drops it. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` L7809–7811 already records six further opener spellings in the wild.
  - Written: 「窗内新派发且 `domain:*` 事件与建卡同分钟者」. Reading on #23720: `domain:devx` labelled 20:01:16Z against `created_at` 20:01:13Z (same minute), `pm:dispatched` labelled 22:26:57Z — in a window covering that hour it is LISTED. Reading on #23665: created 11:24:45Z, `domain:skills` labelled 11:24:47Z (same minute, filer-labelled) but no `pm:dispatched` and no `Claim:` — not listed, which is right: it sits at `pm:retriage`, it was never accepted.
- (f) Confirmed: execution-duties L10 already lists 「无 `pm:retriage`」, so the new line's failure outcome lands on an existing exclusion.

## Executable criterion (from the card)

- A card like #23720 (filer-applied lane, state and grade; lane correct by the table; three items in the body): execution-duties L11 makes it a candidate with no triage touch.
- A card missing either condition: L11 says it is not a candidate and where it goes (`pm:retriage`).
- The triage text names a step that lists self-labelled cards accepted in the window; #23720 appears in it (reading above).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` passes (below).

Every line of the diff is ≤ 120 B; no `#` followed by three or more digits enters any of the three files.

Not run locally, by design: the whole-tree families the derivation marks as CI-owned (`pnpm lint`, the type-check lanes, `check-half-states --format=markdown` with its workflow-supplied provenance) — CI's check-runs on this PR are the reading for those. The two local-only families (`check:dev-prereqs`, `check:skill-frame-freshness`) are not named by the derivation for this diff and were not run.

## Acceptance notes

- The commit's author and committer name was set to `objectstack-fleet[bot]` with a one-off `-c user.name` on the commit command; the configured identity in this container is `Claude` at the same address. Noted, not rewritten.
- Gate 6 first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` not built); the gate's own prescribed build ran under the shared verify lock and the gate was re-run — the table above carries the re-run.
- The new triage line names its window as 「窗内」 rather than spelling `since` a second time: with the actor clause the line is at the 120-byte cap. The window is the one L8 of the same file defines.
- No out-of-scope findings in the three filing classes. Observation only, no card: triage first-touch comments open with at least eight distinct spellings across the corpus and this week's threads, which is why the spot-check keys on the label event's time and not on comment openers.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:执行席现在可以直接认领立卡人自己贴好车道标签的卡,条件两个都要满足:车道按 SKILL.md 的域表是对的、正文有立卡门三件(类别、动手的读者、查重查询与命中数)。任一不满足就挂 `pm:retriage` 交分诊,卡不会悬着没人看。分诊多一条事后抽查:看窗口内新派发、且 `domain:*` 标签是建卡同一分钟贴上的卡,逐张核车道与三件。三个文件各加一行、各删一行重复内容,行数上限一行不动。

**为什么改**:按您 2026-10-15 的原话放宽。此前自贴标签的卡要等分诊首触才能认领,而 sweep 看不到已经带齐标签的卡;量过的一张卡因此多等了约一个半小时,另一张近十二小时无人碰,靶是 `pm:retriage` 才到分诊。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:风险是错车道的卡被执行席直接接下;抽查是补偿控制,抽查判据用标签事件的时间不用 actor(所有舰队写入都是同一个中继身份,actor 分不出立卡人与分诊)。代价为零行数增长。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,三个文件回到原文。

**席位意见**:(留空,席位定稿时填)

**你要做的**:无需动作;本 PR 是 Tier S,席位做完契约复审 PASS 后自行落地。
